notes.title: Master Update for DEMO and Early Access version!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the demo version of our game has been enhanced and updated with significant improvements. Below, you’ll find all the updates included in this release:


Refined Plot: The storyline in the demo version has been adjusted to ensure a clearer and more engaging narrative, providing a better understanding of the game's story.

Improved Voiceovers: The English and Japanese voiceovers have been retained, maintaining their existing quality. However, the Portuguese and Chinese dubs, which were available in the previous version, are undergoing rework and improvements to meet higher standards before being reintroduced.

Interface and Dialogue Languages: For now, the interface and dialogues will only be available in English. Other languages previously available are being revised and optimized to deliver a polished experience in future updates.

Bug Fixes and Inconsistencies: Several bugs and logical inconsistencies present in the previous version have been resolved, ensuring a smoother and more cohesive gameplay experience.

notes.title: New Update 5.3.0: Now Featuring Japanese and Chinese UI and Texts!
notes.notes: Enjoy the Early Access gaming experience with accurately localized texts and dialogues in both languages. I have also corrected grammar errors.

notes.title: Update 5.2.0: A Fresh New Look with Revamped UI and Chinese Texts!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to unveil the highly anticipated Update 5.2.0, bringing a host of exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can look forward to in this latest update:

 Revamped UI: Enjoy a fresh and intuitive Heads-Up Display, designed for a more immersive and user- friendly experience.

 Chinese Localization: We're excited to introduce Chinese dialogue, expanding our reach and making the game more accessible to players around the world.

 Enhanced Voice Acting: English and Japanese voiceovers have been improved, with additional scenes and dialogues to enrich the narrative and bring characters to life.

 Dialogue Improvements: We've made significant corrections and enhancements to the French and German dialogues, ensuring better clarity and immersion.

 Balanced Difficulty: The overall game difficulty has been carefully rebalanced, providing a fairer and more engaging challenge for players of all skill levels.


This update represents a major step forward in our commitment to delivering a top-notch gaming experience. We can't wait for you to dive in and explore all the new features and improvements. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Update: Battle the Nightmare Wraith and Embrace the Melodies of Power!
notes.notes:
Prepare to face the formidable Nightmare Wraith within the dreams of Ettrian, confronting your innermost fears and unlocking hidden truths. Feel the adrenaline rush with our new energetic battle tracks, enhancing the intensity of every encounter.

In addition to these thrilling new features, we've listened to your feedback and made significant improvements across the board. Experience smoother gameplay with enhanced translations in German and French, ensuring a more immersive experience for international players. Encounter even more challenging foes with our revamped enemy AI, providing a true test of your skills. We've also fine-tuned the balance of Ettrian's stats and those of the monsters, creating a more engaging and rewarding gameplay experience.

Furthermore, our Ethereum Nexus system has received a boost, offering even more strategic depth and customization options for your party. Say goodbye to frustratingly frequent random encounters with our refined encounter rate adjustments, allowing for smoother exploration of the game world. Finally, enjoy a more streamlined user experience with adjustments to the game menu windows, making navigation more intuitive than ever before.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! A free demo is coming anytime!
notes.notes:
This update includes:



Bug fixes from the previous version for a smoother gaming experience.

Additional voiceovers in Russian and Korean for an even more immersive experience.

Return of texts in Japanese, French, and German, with the interface temporarily unified in English for Russian and Korean languages. This will not affect saved game progress.

Spelling error corrections in some builds to improve the overall game quality.

The most exciting announcement: a free demo is on the way! Stay tuned for more information.

notes.title: Unleash the Power: Ethereum Nexus Update Now Live + Chinese and Spanish dubbing
notes.notes:
What's New:

Ethereum Nexus Grind System: Discover a dynamic skill tree, earn skill points through battles, and tailor Ettrian's abilities to your playstyle.

Global Dubbing: Ettrian's adventure now speaks multiple languages! Enjoy the epic tale in Spanish, French, German, and Chinese.

Bug Fixes: I've squashed pesky bugs to enhance your gaming experience.

Note: Japanese version temporarily unavailable, but fear not, the Japanese voiceover remains intact!

Don't miss out on this epic update. Join Ettrian on his quest, now with even more depth and excitement. Update now and redefine your journey in Ettrian - The Elf Prince!

notes.title: Unravel the Expanded Saga: Ettrian - The Elf Prince Enhanced Update!
Unravel the Expanded Saga: Ettrian - The Elf Prince Enhanced Update!
notes.notes:
Dive deeper into the mesmerizing world of Ettrian - The Elf Prince with our latest enhanced update! We are thrilled to announce the arrival of a richer, more immersive gameplay experience, tailored just for you.

What's New:

1. Expanded Languages:
Now, immerse yourself in the captivating tale of Ettrian - The Elf Prince with our newly added languages. Hear the characters come to life in French, German, and Chinese, allowing you to truly understand the nuances of their emotions and intentions.

2. Enhanced Interface:
Navigate the enchanting realms of Ettrian with ease! A revamped interface ensures a seamless and intuitive gaming experience. Every menu, every button, crafted with precision to enhance your gameplay.

3. Refined Level Design:
A enhanced level design brings a new layer of excitement and strategy to your journey. Face tougher enemies, solve intricate puzzles, and discover hidden treasures as you progress through the game.

4. Extended Lore:
I've added new scenes, providing a deeper insight into the characters and the enchanting world they inhabit. Witness pivotal moments that shape their destiny, offering you a more profound connection with the story.
